claims.content: To coordinate the transmission of surveillance track data by managing transmit filters between C2 JUs.

goal.raw_text: To coordinate the transmission of surveillance track data by managing transmit filters between C2 JUs.

claims.content: A C2 JU requests that another C2 JU transmit a specific filter.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU requests that another C2 JU transmit a specific filter.

claims.content: The requesting C2 JU sends a Filter Transmission Request message (J7.6 (ACT = 1)) to the requested C2 JU. This message contains the filter number of the filter being requested.
Upon receiving the request, the requested C2 JU checks if it has the specified filter active.

If the filter is active, the requested C2 JU responds by sending a Filter Description Report message (J7.6 (ACT = 2)) back to the requesting C2 JU. This report contains the full description of the requested filter.

If the filter is not active or does not exist, the requested C2 JU may send a Filter Description Report with an empty or null description, or take no action as per local policy (the standard implies a report is sent in response to the request).
The requested C2 JU does not have the requested filter active or defined.
The requesting C2 JU receives a Filter Description Report (J7.6 ACT=2) indicating the filter is not active (e.g., empty description or specific status indicator).
The coordination attempt for that specific filter terminates. The requesting C2 JU may log the failure or notify its operator.
